newsitem.title: USA: AMG sees $827 mln equity fund outflow in past week.
newsitem.headline: AMG sees $827 mln equity fund outflow in past week.

text.p: AMG Data Services said on Friday money flowed out of equity funds in the week ended August 13 for the first time since April.

The firm said $827 million flowed out of equity funds, a small percentage of the $1.5 trillion invested in all equity funds. Most redemptions were in smaller-capitalization and aggressive growth funds, said AMG president Robert Adler.
"This was clearly in response to a negative market," Adler said. "But the fact that this is the first week since the start of April we have any redemptions does not make a trend."
Adler, who said the equity outflows were in response to declines in the stock market, said redemptions from large-capitalization shares was relatively small.
Most of the redemptions were made by people investing in the stock market for shorter-term gains, he said.
